name: Goshujin-sama wa Imouto Desu ka? ~Mkkozuki no Ore ga, Nande Imouto no M Otoko ni!?~
original_name: ご主人様は妹ですか？ ～Ｍっ娘好きの俺が、なんで妹のＭ男に！？～
source:
The Sasazuka family whose parents are posted overseas.
Because Kimihiko had to attend school, he and his younger sister Sarasa stayed here and looked after him while he was away.

Kimihiko is being hit hard by Sarasa.
It’s not that he hates it or anything, it’s just that “calico” has bothered him since he was a child, and it has become his daily routine.

Due to this situation, he has come to like “quiet masochist girls” who are the exact opposite of “chintz”.
He had been stocking up on SM adult goods online for the masochist girl he was destined to meet someday, but one day…

Sarasa threw something at Kimihiko.

“What is this? What on earth is this naughty thing? I found it in my brother’s room!”

A set of goods is found in “Chintz”.

“I’ll tell my mom! My brother said, “I’m buying these things with my allowance.”

“Oh, that’s…”

“If you don’t want that, listen to me.”

Her sister threatened her with a faint smile on her face…
translation:
父母被派驻海外的笹冢家。
由于公彦要上学，他不在的时候，他和妹妹萨拉莎就留在这里照顾他。

公彦受到萨拉莎的重创。
倒不是他讨厌它什么的，只是“印花布”从小就困扰着他，而且已经成为了他的日常。

由于这种情况，他开始喜欢与“印花棉布”完全相反的“安静的受虐女孩”。
他一直在网上为他注定要遇到的受虐女孩储备SM成人用品，但有一天……

更纱向公彦丢了东西。

“这是什么？这淘气的东西到底是什么？我在我哥哥的房间里发现的！”

在“Chintz”中发现了一套商品。

“我去告诉我妈！我哥说，我用零用钱买这些东西。”

“噢，那是……”

“如果你不愿意的话，就听我的。”

姐姐脸上带着淡淡的微笑威胁她……
